description: React component for a draggable and collapsible lane in a Trello-like board, managing cards, scrolling, drag-and-drop, and lane actions.

classes.name: Lane
classes.description: A React component representing a lane in a Trello-like board, supporting card management, drag-and-drop, and collapsing.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll event to load more cards when reaching the bottom.

methods.name: sortCards
methods.description: Sorts cards based on a provided sort function.

methods.name: laneDidMount
methods.description: Attaches scroll event listener to the lane DOM node.

methods.name: UNSAFE_componentWillReceiveProps
methods.description: Updates currentPage state when cards prop changes.

methods.name: removeCard
methods.description: Removes a card from the lane, optionally calling a pre-delete hook.

methods.name: handleCardClick
methods.description: Handles click event on a card.

methods.name: showEditableCard
methods.description: Enables the mode to add a new card.

methods.name: hideEditableCard
methods.description: Disables the mode to add a new card.

methods.name: addNewCard
methods.description: Adds a new card to the lane.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a drag event.

methods.name: shouldAcceptDrop
methods.description: Determines if a drop is acceptable based on source container options.

methods.name: get groupName
methods.description: Returns the group name for drag-and-drop grouping.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a drag event, moving cards across lanes if needed.

methods.name: updateCard
methods.description: Updates a card's data.

methods.name: renderDragContainer
methods.description: Renders the container with cards, including drag-and-drop and add card UI.

methods.name: removeLane
methods.description: Removes the lane.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the lane's title.

methods.name: renderHeader
methods.description: Renders the lane header component.

methods.name: toggleLaneCollapsed
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the lane.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire lane component including header, cards, and footer.
